bias.zh: 反弹 · 失守 $250–256，守住 10 日均线

read.en: Teradyne fell 5.4% on Nov 13 to $249.55, trading $241.08–263.75 on light volume (0.69x the 20-day average). It is above the falling 10-day ($248.3) and below the rising 5-day ($254.1), the falling 30-day ($317.1) and 100-day ($358.4), and the rising 200-day ($350.2). MACD has been above its signal since Nov 12, below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 10 ($217.24), and RSI is 37.3.
read.zh: 泰瑞达 11月13日下跌 5.4%，收于 $249.55，盘中区间 $241.08–263.75，成交量偏低（20 日均量的 0.69 倍）。股价位于下行的 10 日均线（$248.3）上方，上行的 5 日均线（$254.1）、下行的 30 日（$317.1）和 100 日均线（$358.4）以及上行的 200 日均线（$350.2）下方。MACD 自 11月12日起位于信号线上方，在零轴下方；抛物线 SAR 自 11月10日起看多（$217.24），RSI 为 37.3。

read.en: The drop broke the $250–256 support (Nov 12 low, 5-day, Nov 10–11 levels), now resistance, but the close held the 10-day. Resistance is $250–254.8, then $263.8–270.7 (Nov 13 and Nov 12 highs) and $273.2–278. Support is $245.4–248.3 (10-day, Nov 4 low), then $237.6–241.1 (Nov 10 and 13 lows) and $217.2–222.5 (SAR, Nov 9 low). A close above $254.8 would target $264–266; below $245.4, $238–241.
